apparatus.note: The original 1901 margin notes “Or, word. Compare Acts 5.20.” This is a historical translation alternative, not a replacement for “Word of life” in the printed text.
The original printed margin supplies “Or, Comforter” and “Or, Helper” with Greek Paraclete in relation to advocate. The main text remains “advocate.”
The 1901 margin reads “Some ancient authorities read annulleth Jesus.” The printed main-text reading is retained without replacing it with the note.

The original ASV1901 main text uses its shorter wording for witnesses in 1 John 5:7–8. Do not import extended later-tradition wording into the 1901 edition; the original printed page remains decisive.
The original margin records “Some ancient authorities read him.” The main text remains as printed.
